timingContract: Keyboard event timestamp -> local model revision observed in RAF -> two more RAF callbacks. Historical input-only boundary also recorded as inputToFrame; no interval shortened for PASS. This is a presentation upper bound, not a hardware presentation timestamp. API intervals exclude app JS outside the call; session spans in attribution include full readPages/mutation/scheduling. Commit acknowledgement is a JS-observed round trip including delivery scheduling, not Rust CPU time.
control: Engine snapshotCapacity refusal is injected by the test harness only to exercise existing disabled-history policy. Actual pinned engine capacity remains100; this is a synthetic control, not natural capacity evidence.
activationDecision: NO-GO: observed >50ms group-start p95; memory acceptance unresolved.

API getPageInfo spans exclude readPages JavaScript; successful full readPages directly profiled in latest supplemental build.
Initial IPC monkeypatch did not observe calls; zero values are not backend cost evidence. Replaced with session-side scheduling/ack trace spans.
